subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after_compaction hooks gain a public, current-session-only deferred resetSession API across OpenClaw and bundled harnesses?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin capability and establishes permanent rules for session authority, model-locked sessions, harness propagation, and caller finalization; tests cannot determine whether maintainers want that public contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred API after the two code findings, documentation, compatibility coverage, and exact-head runtime proof are complete.

options.title: Keep reset authority internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and solve the observed workflow through an internal compaction-owner seam or plugin-specific integration.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred API after the two code findings, documentation, compatibility coverage, and exact-head runtime proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history match for the existing compaction lifecycle hook contract being expanded.
